name: yf_options_chain
description:
Option chain (calls and puts) for one underlying and expiry from Yahoo Finance (yfinance option_chain).
Returns: {symbol, expiry, total_calls, total_puts, truncated, calls: [...], puts: [...]}, each list the first limit contracts in Yahoo's strike order, with contractSymbol, lastTradeDate, strike, lastPrice, bid, ask, change, percentChange, volume, openInterest, impliedVolatility, inTheMoney, contractSize, currency; {"error": "No options available"} when there are none.
Inputs (* required): symbol*; expiry (YYYY-MM-DD from yf_options_expiries; default the nearest expiry); limit (contracts per side, 1-500; default 50).
Other source: openbb_options_chains.
Example: {"symbol": "AAPL", "limit": 20}

limit.description: Most calls and puts each returned (1-500)
